title: Combinatorial Yamabe flow on infinitely triangulated hyperbolic surfaces
summary: We study the combinatorial Yamabe flow on infinitely triangulated surfaces with piecewise hyperbolic metrics. Under the assumptions of uniformly bounded vertex degree and an $ε$-uniformly nondegenerate initial metric, we establish the short-time existence and uniqueness of smooth solutions to the combinatorial Yamabe flow.
